data.content_ref: inline:Leave the fixpoint untouched and add an interface-level guarantee: for every committed root, emit a short certificate (defender set plus defeat chain) that any external party can verify in polynomial time. Committed-root validity becomes externally auditable without changing the skeptical semantics at all. Criticizable because certificates are themselves artifacts and add storage and serialization cost, and because verifying a certificate does not strengthen the semantics — it only makes the existing validity claim checkable by parties who do not trust the prover.
